subject: Workplace Skills
title: Formal vs Informal Power
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Formal vs Informal Power.

hook.text: A junior assistant controlled which items reached the CEO's agenda. She had more power than most VPs.

buildup.text: Formal power comes from title and org chart. Informal power comes from access, knowledge, and trust.

discovery.text: The person who controls information flow often wields more influence than the person with the title.

twist.text: Titles change with reorgs. Relationships endure. Informal power is more durable than formal authority.

climax.text: Map who has informal influence in your organization. They are your real decision gatekeepers.

punchline.text: The org chart shows titles. Watch who has real sway.

quiz.question: What gives someone informal power in an organization?
options: Access to information, relationships, and trust
The number of direct reports they manage
